name: Reviewed baselines support bounded impact; unreviewed baselines require initial examination
description: Reviewed baselines support bounded impact; unreviewed baselines require initial examination.

passage.quote: A revised responsibility expands the investigation to its parent, the dependencies it relies on, and descriptions that depend on it. An unchanged decision stops expansion through that responsibility and must include a concrete reason. For a baseline without a review bound to its exact content, the initial investigation covers all descriptions before bounded change investigations can be trusted.
